card.title: Journal name - IJRASET, ISSN: 2321-9653, (International Journal for Research in Applied Science & Engineering Technology)
highlights: Title - Live Vision (Multi-Objects Classification & Detection System)
Research Domain (AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, Web Development)

This research focuses on developing a real-time computer vision system capable of detecting and analyzing objects from live camera feeds. The system utilizes deep learning and image processing techniques to identify objects, extract meaningful information, and provide instant visual insights.
